operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/BKSY.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: Operating cash flow -28311000 divided by net income -70260000, for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31, both from companyfacts. fcf_margin is omitted (not written as NULL) because companyfacts carries no capex line for BlackSky, so free cash flow cannot be computed; the schema requires only one of the two cash-conversion fields and this one is measurable.
